chunks: Ismaʿīl ibn Muslim narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:
The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said: “It is not permissible for a woman who is menstruating to adopt a quṣṣah or a jummah.”

key_terms.تَتَّخِذَ: to adopt, take, or make use of
key_terms.جُمَّةً: jummah; a named item or style mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.قُصَّةً: quṣṣah; a named item or style mentioned in the hadith

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about what is not permissible for a menstruating woman?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله concerning a menstruating woman and the impermissibility of adopting certain forms described as quṣṣah and jummah. The report is transmitted through Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام from his forefathers عليهم السلام.
